name: Corporate Action Election 3
definition: Provides information about a corporate action election.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

InstructedUnderlyingSecuritiesQuantity.name: Instructed Underlying Securities Quantity
InstructedUnderlyingSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity of underlying securities to which this instruction applies.

InstructedSecuritiesQuantityToReceive.name: Instructed Securities Quantity To Receive
InstructedSecuritiesQuantityToReceive.definition: Quantity of the benefits that the account owner wants to receive, eg, as a result of dividend reinvestment.

ProposedRate.name: Proposed Rate
ProposedRate.definition: Rate proposed in a remarketing of variable rate notes.

CashMovementDetails.name: Cash Movement Details
CashMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the cash movement resulting from the election instruction.

SecuritiesMovementDetails.name: Securities Movement Details
SecuritiesMovementDetails.definition: Provides information about the securities movement resulting from the election instruction.
